news.headline: Bonfiglioli Transmissions announces Rs 2,534-cr IPO; price band set at Rs 558-586/sh
news.summary: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Ltd has set the IPO price band between Rs 558 and Rs 586. The subscription window will open from October 15 to October 19, with anchor investors allowed to bid a day prior on October 14. This IPO is exclusively an offer for sale initiated by the promoter, Bonfiglioli SpA, and share listings are expected on both BSE and NSE by October 23.

news.headline: India’s 10-year bond yield hits 3-year high as RBI’s liquidity measure weighs on demand
news.summary: Indian government bonds extended losses on Monday, pushing the benchmark 10-year yield to a three-year high as the RBI’s latest liquidity-tightening measures added to selling pressure. Tighter banking-system liquidity can curb banks’ capacity to invest in government securities, weakening bond demand and pushing prices lower and yields higher.

news.headline: Indian debt funds set to extend $4.5 billion bond selloff after RBI policy shift
news.summary: Indian mutual funds have sold $4.5 billion in government bonds since July, prompted by changing rate expectations. The Reserve Bank of India raised rates for the first time in nearly four years, signaling further increases. Many asset managers are shifting to short-duration assets to mitigate risks associated with rising yields. Fund managers have noticed an increase in long-term bond yields reaching nearly three-year highs.

news.headline: HCL Tech Q2 Results: Profit jumps 21% YoY to Rs 5,132 crore; co declares Rs 12/share dividend
news.summary: HCL Tech Q2 Results: HCL Tech reported a 21% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 5,132 crore, while revenue grew 12% to Rs 35,620 crore. The IT major declared an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share, retained its FY27 margin guidance and reported strong AI revenue growth and deal wins.

news.headline: India 10-year bond yield tops 7.35% as RBI's liquidity clamp down hurts
news.summary: On Monday, Indian government bonds experienced a significant decline due to central bank measures affecting liquidity. The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield rose to its highest level in three years. The Reserve Bank of India announced it would sell 250 billion rupees of bonds to tighten liquidity. Meanwhile, the benchmark Brent crude price remained above $100 per barrel, impacting inflation.

news.headline: Will RBI’s CRR hike to 99% hit HDFC, SBI and other bank stocks? Here’s what Jefferies says
news.summary: The RBI has raised the minimum daily CRR maintenance requirement to 99% from 90% from October 16 to curb banking system liquidity. Jefferies expects a limited impact on banks’ net interest margins, estimating a potential 1-2 basis point increase in funding costs. It prefers banks over NBFCs in a rising-rate environment and sees up to 47% upside in Bandhan Bank.

news.headline: HCL Tech shares rise 2% ahead of IT major’s Q2 earnings announcement today. What to expect?
news.summary: HCL Technologies shares rose ahead of the IT major’s Q2 FY27 results, with brokerages expecting around 12% year-on-year growth in net profit and 16% growth in revenue. Acquisitions, deal ramp-ups and seasonal strength are likely to support performance, while investors will watch for a revision in the company’s guidance.

news.headline: RBI measures, intervention spark rupee's sharpest rally in six months
news.summary: On Monday, the Indian rupee gained about 1% after the Reserve Bank of India announced measures to curb dollar demand. Oil companies' dollar purchases will now be directed away from the spot market, easing pressure on the rupee. This intervention aims to address the mounting balance of payments challenges due to high oil prices. However, analysts remain cautious about the sustainability of the rupee's recovery moving forward.

news.headline: Sunil Singhania adds new stock to portfolio in Q2 after 140% rally; likely exits Cyient DLM
news.summary: Veteran investor Sunil Singhania's Abakkus Flexi Cap Fund acquired a 1.15% stake in Aether Industries and raised its holdings in Heritage Foods during Q2 FY27. Meanwhile, the fund appears to have exited Cyient DLM as its holding dropped below 1% following a sharp multi-month rally.

news.headline: Telecom stocks under fire, sink up to 13% as Elon Musk’s Starlink buys spectrum from Grain Management
news.summary: SpaceX’s move to acquire low-band spectrum licences has intensified concerns about disruption in the US telecom industry, sending shares of Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile lower. The company plans to combine satellite connectivity with terrestrial infrastructure to expand Starlink Mobile coverage. The deal, alongside regulatory approval for its next-generation satellite constellation, signals an escalation in SpaceX’s challenge to established wireless operators.

news.headline: FIIs cut stakes in 12 stocks in September quarter; shares fall up to 27% in 3 months
news.summary: FIIs reduced stakes in 36 of 68 BSE 500 companies reporting September-quarter shareholding data. Twelve stocks fell up to 27% over three months as foreign investors trimmed holdings.

news.headline: Global Market: Eurozone bond yields ease as Russia-Ukraine energy truce lifts sentiment
news.summary: Eurozone government bond yields eased as lower energy prices and a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire announcement improved investor sentiment. German yields declined, while French and Italian bond spreads narrowed. However, markets continued pricing in higher European Central Bank rates, with geopolitical risks and inflation remaining key concerns for investors.

news.headline: Jio IPO may be valued at Rs 11 lakh crore: What it means for RIL, Bharti Airtel and telecom stocks
news.summary: Jio Platforms’ proposed Rs 30,000 crore IPO could become India’s biggest-ever share sale, valuing Mukesh Ambani’s digital business at up to Rs 11 lakh crore. With global and domestic investors showing interest, the listing will test Jio’s valuation against Bharti Airtel, potentially reshape telecom sector dynamics and offer investors a direct route to participate in Reliance’s digital growth story.

news.headline: Banks seek RBI relief, clarity on India's latest rupee-defence measures: Report
news.summary: Banks have approached the Reserve Bank of India to request changes to the 20% cash deposit mandate. They propose that a flat charge replaces the deposit requirement for current-account hedging. This change could improve liquidity while ensuring cost transparency for businesses. Lenders also highlighted concerns over the $2 million threshold, which complicates hedge tracking. Clarity is needed regarding the deposit requirement for hedges related to interest payments on foreign loans.

news.headline: TCS shares rally 6% in 2 sessions after Q2 results. What are technicals indicating for the IT major?
news.summary: TCS reported a 15% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 13,884 crore and declared an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share.
